card.name: Linking words before a condition
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, with, at, the) that come right before a named condition or procedure, mostly in contraindication and avoid-use statements, such as 'in the setting of' or 'in patients with'.

modes.label: Setting of
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'contraindicated in the setting', before CABG surgery.
modes.example: is contraindicated in the setting<< of>> coronary artery bypass graft (CABG

modes.description: The word 'with' after 'avoid use ... in patients', before a disease.
